basic_info.main_problem: I feel embarrassed and unconfident about my terrible singing, especially when friends joke about it.
basic_info.core_demands: Persistent negative thoughts and embarrassment about singing have begun to affect my confidence and overall well-being, so I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: mocked by peers for singing since adolescence, initially moderate stress, but increasingly prominent in Social situations over time; to avoid further embarrassment and mockery, gradually avoiding singing or karaoke activities; whenever friends mention my singing, embarrassment and low self-worth surge; though relationships are affected, some friends are still willing to do activities together, but I have not shared these feelings with them.

core_beliefs: My worth depends on how others evaluate me

special_situations.event: At a gathering with friends, friends joke about his singing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if others mock my singing, it means they look down on me, and I as a person am not recognized either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: avoiding singing-related topics and activities, trying not to sing in Social situations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: they really think I am terrible, looking down on me

special_situations.event: Invited to karaoke or social activities that may require singing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I sing badly, I will definitely embarrass myself and be mocked
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Refuses or avoids such invitations, reduces attending gatherings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I go sing, it will definitely be embarrassing and they will laugh at me

special_situations.event: A friend mentions his singing level in conversation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: bad singing is not only a skill issue, it also shows I as a person am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to improve his voice by watching tutorials online to reduce the risk of being mocked

special_situations.event: Friends comment on his singing in a light joking manner
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: friends' jokes target me as a person, negating me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Treats jokes as attacks, strengthening self-defense and avoiding discussing this topic with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are laughing at me as a person

core_conflict.wish: longing to be accepted and appreciated by friends (including kindly tolerating parts one is not good at)
core_conflict.fear: fear of being humiliated, mocked and belittled (and thus Being rejected)
defense_goal: maintaining Self-protection and safety by avoiding singing and related occasions, reducing exposure of weaknesses

object_relations.self_representation: An easily mocked, shamed person being evaluated
object_relations.object_representation: Peers inclined toward judgment and mockery
object_relations.linking_affect: Embarrassment, shame, low sense of self-worth
